MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  June 14, 2022
NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action taken
by the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the only record
of official City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they are approved by
the City Council at its next regularly scheduled meeting.

CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority,
Library Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

Called to order at 5:00 p.m.

  INVOCATION: Mayor Pro Tem Sachs

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Bucknum

  PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Hometown Hero Presentation

  Mayor Bucknum presented Lucy Dunn with Hometown Hero Proclamation.

  P2.  Adopted Headquarters Battalion of the 1st Marine Division Quarterly Recognition

  Mayor Bucknum presented certificates of commendation to the "Marine of the Quarter"
  Lance Corporal Andres Cervantes, and "Noncommissioned Officer of the Quarter" Sergeant
  Destiny Dempsey.

  P3.  Proclamation for the 50th Anniversary of Title IX

  Mayor Bucknum presented Elizabeth Busick with a proclamation.

  P4.  Mission Viejo High School Girls Softball Team Recognition

  Mayor Bucknum recognized Mission Viejo High School Girls Softball Team for their CIF
  Division II Championship.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  S/K  Approved the Consent Calendar as outlined below.

City Council Summary  1  June 14, 2022
   1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of May 24, 2022, as presented.

  2.  Check Register Dated May 13, 2022 in the Amount of $2,446,181.48

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  3.  Check Register Dated May 20, 2022 in the Amount of $1,446,893.93

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  4.  Check Register Dated May 27, 2022 in the Amount of $872,791.67

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  5.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for April 2022

  Received and filed.

  6.  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer’s Monthly Report
  for April 2022

  Received and filed.

  7.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer’s
  Monthly Report for April 2022

  Received and filed.

  8.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for April 2022

  Received and filed.

  9.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo -Third Quarter FY 2021-22

  Received and filed.

  11.  Professional Services Consultant Team

  (1) Approved the Professional Services Consultant Team Roster (for plan check/design or
  other professional services); (2) authorized the City Manager to execute contracts with
  members of the Professional Services Consultant Team as needed; (3) authorized the City
  Manager to add consultants to the Professional Services Consultant Team Roster as needed
  during the contract term.

  12.  Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Project (TRAP): Catch Basin Debris
  Screen and Automated Retractable Screen Installations in the North Central City Area
  (CIP 22250)

  Awarded the construction contract in the amount of $200,000.00 to G2 Construction, Inc.,
  (A22-18) for the subject project.
City Council Summary  2  June 14, 2022
   13.  Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Project (TRAP) - 2022 Measure M2 ECP
  Grant Application

  Adopted Resolution 22-13 Authorizing an Application for Funds for the Environmental
  Cleanup, Tier 1 Grant Program Under Orange County Local Transportation Ordinance No.
  3 for the Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Projects.

  14.  Amendment to the City of Mission Viejo Renewed Measure M (M2) Seven-Year Capital
  Improvement Program

  Authorized the Director of Public Works to process an administrative amendment to the City
  of Mission Viejo Renewed Measure M (M2) Seven-Year Capital Improvement Program with
  the Orange County Transportation Authority, beginning with the 2021/22 fiscal year, to re-
  insert three completed, CIP projects funded with M2 grant funds back into the FY2021/22 7-
  Year CIP: the MV Trash & Runoff Abatement: Central; the Mission Viejo TRAP: Via
  Fabricante Area; and the Los Alisos Blvd/Santa Margarita Parkway Intersection Widening;
  and further, to add $40,000 in M2 funding for the District 5 Regional Bikeways: Mission
  Viejo N/S Corridor Trail & Jeronimo/Chrisanta Trail OCTA CMAQ grant project, for
  FY2021/22.

  15.  2022 Fourth of July Community Street Faire

  Approved the Special Events Permit submitted by the Mission Viejo Activities Committee
  authorizing the annual Mission Viejo Fourth of July Community Street Faire on Monday,
  July 4, 2022.

  16.  Contract Renewal with Mercy House Living Centers for Homeless Outreach Services

  Approved Mercy House Living Centers Contract (A22-19) for Homeless Outreach Services
  for $88,000.

  ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

  10.  Highway Bridge Program (HBP) Grant: La Paz Bridge and Road Widening Project
  (CIP 01756)

  B/K  Adopted Resolution 22-12 Approving and Authorizing Execution of Program Supplement No.
  M014 Rev. 1 to the Administering Agency-State Master Agreement No. 12-5451 for Federal
  Aid Projects between the State Department of Transportation and the City of Mission Viejo.

  NEW BUSINESS

  17.  City Operating and Capital Improvement Program Revised Budget - Fiscal Year
  2022/23

  B/S  (1) Adopted Resolution 22-14 Adopting a Revised Budget for the City of Mission Viejo for
  Fiscal Year 2022-23 and Appropriating Funds for Fiscal Year 2022-23; and (2) adopt
  Resolution 22-15 Amending the Authorized Position Schedule and the City’s Salary Schedule
  Effective July 1, 2022.
City Council Summary  3  June 14, 2022
   MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  18.  Local Agency Formation Commission (LAFCO) Report

  Received report.

  19.  Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA) Report

  Receive report.

  CITY MANAGER REPORT

  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT

  COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  20.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  Received reports.

  Council Member Goodell

  Council Member Kelley

  Council Member Raths

  Mayor Pro Tem Sachs

  Mayor Bucknum

Adjournment at 8:27 pm to Tuesday, June 28, 2022, at 5:00 pm

City Council Summary  4  June 14, 2022
